pr_auc_definition: sklearn average_precision_score (weighted step function over precision-recall curve)

temporal_validation_reconciliation.explanation: Expanding validation evaluated all 6 folds (Apr-Sep, including low-prevalence April PR-AUC=0.4998). Hyperparameter search evaluated 3 representative convective onset/peak folds (May, Jul, Sep). Both are mathematically consistent.

calibration_audit.explanation: Brier score drop from 0.1264 in validation to 0.0384 in test is mathematically governed by the seasonal base-rate prevalence shift (31.72% summer down to 6.83% autumn/winter). The Brier Skill Score remains virtually identical (~40-41%), proving consistent skill.

spatial_holdout_audit.interpretation: Evaluates spatial geographic transferability to unseen Florida stations within the same temporal window (Jan-Sep 2024). Confirms model generalizes without station memorization.
